evidence_boundary: All issue arbitration, context scheduling and service delays remain configurable hypotheses. Allocation arithmetic is CUDA-toolkit-derived, not private partition placement. No multi-SM runtime prediction follows from this refactor.

minimal_new_modules.name: resident_native_stage_engine.sv
edits: Add CONTEXTS=2 and context index to scalar/vector shared writes, request admission, response and traces.
Lift pc/control/barriers/A/B/MOVM/C/readiness/live-operation arrays from [warp] to [context][warp]; shared operand memory becomes [context][2048halfwords].
Replace single state/saved_id/round_robin with context_state[CONTEXTS], saved_id[CONTEXTS], and one round-robin cursor across CONTEXTS*WARPS eligible candidates.
KEEP exactlyone warp_shared_read_service, one native_movm_word_pipeline and one native_hmma16816_adapter. All contexts compete for these exact same capacities, intervals and return ports.

Choose candidate by decoded gate eligibility and actual resource capacity; dispatch_ready stays actual service readiness. Maintain one accepted instruction globally per edge initially, labeled a schedule assumption.
Route every actual service response to owning context/warp/PC; per-context service-live and barrier counts must drain independently. Response for one context must not require all other contexts idle.
Arbitrate buffered context responses round-robin and hold selected context/id/data stable until acknowledgement.

minimal_new_modules.name: resident_cta_grid_controller.sv
edits: Instantiate one quantized_block_admission with BLOCK_SLOTS=CONTEXTS; admit_valid only when a grid block and a free context are available.
Latch block ordinal, row/column, immutable bases and kernel resource receipt into admitted_slot on exactly the same accepted admission edge.
Maintain per-context global-staging/reduction/output/CTA-barrier state; do not instantiate a complete studied_gemm_cta_controller per slot because that would duplicate native services and caches.
Send each prepared stage through shared resident_native_stage_engine using allocated context index. Barrier generations belong to context and cannot be globally reset by another context going idle.
Retire admission slot only after final output acknowledgements, no live stage/read/move/matrix/store token, no pending scratch work and all context barrier releases acknowledged.
Grid done requires all block ordinals admitted/completed exactly once and resident_blocks==0; scheduler must keep admitting new blocks while earlier contexts execute.

context_identity.epoch: Increment a per-context epoch at each stage acceptance; compare completion epoch with its recorded active operation. Reject wrap rather than aliasing old events.
context_identity.decoding: Extract low LOCAL_BITS to derive context/warp/pc; high bits are epoch. Gate operation tag remains local PC within its context/warp.
context_identity.why: Simple context*160+warp*40+pc repeats across stages/slot reuse and can misroute stale completions; epoch ownership is required.
context_identity.provider_reset: External memory providers flush old transactions; internal context epoch/reset rules alone cannot revoke already committed external writes.

shared_storage.physical_budget_accounting: Reserve8192 user bytes plus1024 reserved bytes per admitted saved small CTA, rounded128. Do not reserve only4096 because current operand engine omits the output scratch allocation.
shared_storage.model_arrays: Separate context arrays are address isolation, not independent bank bandwidth. Encode bank-local byte address from context offset while retaining32bank mapping of each CTA-aligned region.
shared_storage.scratch_refactor: Move scratch arrays and pending STS/LDS state into per-context storage; output scratch LDS must use same shared read service as operand loads. Bank writes also need one shared service arbiter, not a private write port per context.

global_memory_gap.current_problem: Each studied CTA embeds its own coalesced warp loader/cache; blindly instantiating multiple controllers creates independent caches/backing capacities.
global_memory_gap.minimum_resolution: Separate coalesced_u16 request grouping from cache ownership; one SM-level sector cache/packet service arbitrates tagged context requests and returns packets to per-context grouping state.
global_memory_gap.output: One coalesced_fp32 sector-store queue/arbiter carries context+operation identity and actual masked-store acknowledgements.
global_memory_gap.defer_boundary: A first numerical resident-stage test may use preloaded per-context shared values, but cannot claim whole-grid resident integration or hardware runtime.

directed_acceptance_tests: Two contexts contain distinct input words at same local shared addresses; neither context may read the other.
READ_SLOTS=1 and long MOVM/HMMA delays force contexts to contend for the same actual service queues.
Interleaved issue trace must show both contexts progress before either completes; total service instances remain exactlyone per class.
Holding one context result does not block independent completion unless actual shared response/storage capacity is exhausted.
Retirement of contextA while contextB active preserves B resource allocations, pending barrier counts and service tokens.
Stale epoch completion after slot/stage reuse must be rejected.
Resource accounting reaches saved11CTA limit with exact8192+1024byte demands; contextcapacity2 tests must not pretend2 is physical residentlimit.
Shared scratch reads contend with operand reads through samebank service; no ideal-bypass numerical output.
Reset cancels all contexts and child services; provider flush required; verify no old token routes into new admission.
